description: This Java class defines a custom ViewGroup layout called ApplicationsStackLayout used for arranging application icons in a home screen, supporting vertical and horizontal orientations, with specific layout logic for recents, favorites, and a button.

classes.name: ApplicationsStackLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup for stacking application icons in a home screen layout supporting vertical and horizontal orientations.

methods.name: ApplicationsStackLayout
methods.description: Constructor initializing the layout with context and attribute set.

methods.name: initLayout
methods.description: Initializes layout components, inflates button, and sets background.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws background behind recents and favorites areas based on orientation.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the layout, enforcing EXACTLY measure specs.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions child views including recents, favorites, and button.

methods.name: layoutVertical
methods.description: Arranges child views vertically from bottom up.

methods.name: layoutHorizontal
methods.description: Arranges child views horizontally from right to left.

methods.name: stackApplications
methods.description: Stacks application icons in specified list within the layout.

methods.name: removeAllApplications
methods.description: Removes all application icon views except the button.

methods.name: createApplicationIcon
methods.description: Creates a TextView icon for an application with icon and title.

methods.name: setFavorites
methods.description: Sets the list of favorite applications and requests layout update.

methods.name: setRecents
methods.description: Sets the list of recent applications and requests layout update.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on application icons to start associated activity.
